name: account-management-engine
description: 4 Claude Code skills for the retention & growth block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: client health check (6-criteria green/yellow/red scoring with action plans), upsell mapper (client × services cross-sell matrix with prioritized entry moves), case study writer (project → publishable case in the 12-section Case Study Kit structure, 3 output formats), and deep company analyser (deep account/customer research → pains, triggers, customer language, competitive positioning; powers account dossiers). Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
